columns._doc: Column-band labeling of the XYCut claim lane (pdfdig-ir Get-ColumnBands). narrow_width_frac: blocks narrower than this fraction of text width participate in left-edge clustering; cluster_gap_frac: a left-edge gap larger than this fraction of text width starts a new cluster; span_width_frac: blocks at least this wide are labeled 'span'; assign_tolerance_frac: slack when matching a block's left edge to a cluster range. Values tuned on specimen 2508.11646 (two-column IEEE).

rules._doc: Thin-bbox rule tagging in the paths lane. A non-bezier path whose bbox is at most max_thickness_pt thick and at least min_length_pt long is tagged hrule/vrule. Specimen 2508.11646: 14 hrules + 7 vrules across 18 pages.

figure_regions._doc: CONSUMER PHASE (pdfdig-figures.ps1): cluster each page's Lane-4 vector-path bboxes into figure regions via hdbscan.exe rectangle-gap (density over white-space gaps); stray rules fall out as noise (-1). Per-page. min_pts/min_cluster_size = HDBSCAN density params; a page with at most min_pts paths is grouped as one region flagged too_few_to_cluster. allow_single_cluster lets a lone figure be one cluster while still splitting well-separated multi-figure pages. KIND tagging (nothing dropped): a region whose union bbox is thinner than degenerate_min_extent_pt on either axis is kind=degenerate (a rule/line cluster, ~zero area); otherwise a mark when its TEXT-NORMALIZED area (area / body_font_pt^2 = em^2, i.e. how many glyphs big it is) is below min_region_area_em2; else a big-but-SPARSE region (ink density = paths / em^2 below min_region_density) is kind=sparse -- a phantom where a few furniture/QED strokes' union bbox spans a text column (a footnote rule + scattered QED squares would otherwise read as a ~2000 em^2 'figure'); else a figure. DENSITY, not area, separates a big DENSE diagram from a big SPARSE phantom (area alone cannot). em^2 makes the mark floor transport across page AND font size (a mark is glyph-scale, <~1 em^2; a figure is diagram-scale). NB rule-tagged strokes are KEPT in clustering -- in this corpus figures ARE largely axis-aligned rules (interval bars, diagram arrows/axes), so excluding them shatters real figures (ph-zigzag 2111.15058v3: 29% of Figure 2's ink is hrules); furniture-only regions are rejected by the density gate instead. Corpus evidence (14-paper inbox scan 2026-07-03): the mark/figure split is NOT universally bimodal -- many papers are a size continuum from fragmented complex figures -- so this is a conservative glyph-scale FLOOR (catches true marks, ~2 em^2 = the old 200pt2 at 10pt), NOT a bimodal-valley estimate. min_region_area_pt2 is the fallback floor used only when body_font_pt can't be read (letters lane absent). fragmentation_flag_min_clusters: a page yielding more than this many regions triggers the DE-FRAGMENTATION pass (defrag_enabled): the consumer walks the per-page dendrogram for the fragment-adjacency elbow (the largest log-gap in the distances at which DISTINCT sub-clusters first merge -- below it = intra-figure fragment joins, above = inter-figure/column), and re-runs hdbscan with that distance as --cluster-selection-epsilon so intra-figure fragments merge while figures stay separate. defrag_min_elbow_log_gap: the elbow's log-gap must exceed this or the page is left alone (no clear structure -> don't merge a continuum). summary.fragmentation_suspect_pages counts triggered pages; summary.defragged_pages counts those actually merged. CAPTION reattachment (caption_enabled): each kind=figure region is associated with its caption -- the nearest Lane-3 text block directly BELOW it (figures) or, failing that, ABOVE (tables), horizontally overlapping by at least caption_min_overlap_frac of the NARROWER of figure/block width (min() -- a short 'Fig. N' caption fully under a wide figure must not be rejected by a figure-width denominator; the cue + gap gates still exclude in-text references) and within caption_max_gap_em text-heights vertically. GEOMETRY finds the candidates (adjacent, overlapping, within gap); the caption_cue_words match (Figure/Fig/Table N, prefix-scanned in the block's first ~14 chars) SELECTS the caption among them -- an adjacent section heading or body paragraph (no cue) is NOT attached, and a caption-less region stays null rather than grabbing the wrong block; a mid-sentence 'see Figure 3' reference is excluded by both the length cap and non-adjacency. The region's caption field carries {block_id, bbox, text, cue, position, gap}; summary.captioned_figures counts hits. SUBFIGURE GROUPING (subfigure_grouping_enabled): after caption reattachment, kind=figure regions that share the SAME caption (page, block_id) are merged into ONE region -- a \begin{figure} float with N side-by-side subfigures yields N regions that each reattach to the float's single caption below them, so the shared caption is the ground-truth grouping signal (each float has exactly one caption), making this principled rather than a spatial threshold. Union bbox + concatenated members + recomputed area/density; kind stays figure; flag=subfigure_merged. Matches the oracle's float granularity and yields ONE faithful figure crop (all panels + shared caption) instead of N. summary.subfigure_groups / subfigures_merged count it.

script._doc: CLASSIFIER-PHASE (not consulted by the substrate emitter). Sub/superscript call from size ratio + baseline delta, ported from Markpig Extractor.cs constants (validated on p1..p5 in recon): a glyph smaller than size_ratio_max x line size whose baseline deviates beyond sub_min_drop/super_min_rise points is a script candidate.

line_grouping._doc: CLASSIFIER-PHASE. Baseline clustering tolerance in points (Extractor.cs GroupLines) and the gap fraction of line size treated as an inter-word space (Extractor.cs SpaceFrac; PDFs encode spaces as gaps, not glyphs).

headings._doc: CLASSIFIER-PHASE heading-candidate call from per-document calibration: a line whose modal size is at least min_size_ratio_over_body x body size sits in the tier ladder; a line at body size qualifies when at least bold_line_frac of its letters are bold-by-name (the -Medi/CMBX cue — IsBold flag is unreliable, capability map 1a). Candidates are cross-derived against the bookmark outline (normalized contains-match, page +/-1) — confirmation is a flag, never a gate. tier_merge_gap_pt: adjacent ladder sizes closer than this merge into one tier BAND — office pipelines emit continuous size jitter (specimen 2504.09042: 18 raw sizes 16.3-16.7 etc), not TeX's quantized magsteps; more than max_tiers_before_flag bands after merging flags tier_ladder_noisy.

display_math._doc: CLASSIFIER-PHASE formula-block call: a line whose math-role letter fraction is at least min_math_frac, no wider than max_width_frac_of_block of its block, emits as formula-block. Consecutive formula lines closer than stack_gap_factor x line size share a formula group and are flagged needs_2d_assembly (fractions/matrices pending the C# AST tier).

math_assembler._doc: 1.5-D math structure assembler (math-assembler.ps1): recursive size-tier script nesting for display math. size_ratio: a glyph smaller than base*size_ratio can be a script (CM ladder 10/7/5 -> 0.75 separates tiers); baseline_tol_frac: baseline delta beyond this fraction of the glyph's own size counts as displaced (sub/super). Inverts TeX's forward script placement so t/v/(i+1) at sizes 10/7/5 assemble as t_{v_{i+1}} not the invalid flat t_{v}_{1}.

furniture._doc: CLASSIFIER-PHASE marker call (running heads, page numbers, the arXiv stamp): a line whose baseline sits within margin_frac of the page top/bottom at no more than body size, or whose modal orientation is not Horizontal (rotated stamps/sidebars).

dla._doc: DLA algorithm option overrides (IDlaOptions), applied when constructing segmenter/word-extractor instances. Empty = library defaults (Docstrum within=3.0/between=1.3, XYCut MinimumWidth=1). Populate per-domain when a specimen motivates it.
